description: Publish a dashboard and return its share URL. A customer dashboard is always login-gated, so its customers sign in with the logins you created. An internal dashboard can be published as 'public' (anyone with the link) or 'protected' (one shared username and password).

access.description: For internal dashboards: 'public' means anyone with the link, 'protected' requires a shared username and password. Ignored for customer dashboards, which always require a per-customer login. Defaults to 'protected'.

password.description: Shared password, for 'protected' access. Leave empty to have one generated and returned once.

name: publish_dashboard
title: Publish a dashboard
